claims.text: Krakoa captures the original team, feeds on their mutant energy and deliberately lets Cyclops escape to lure more mutants.
The 1975 issue has Xavier recruit an international rescue team including Storm, Wolverine and Nightcrawler; it establishes the new X-Men.
The new team finds captives on Krakoa; the island itself is the mutant and its apparent escape was bait.
Xavier helps identify the plan: Storm channels lightning to Polaris, Cyclops and Havok add blasts, and Polaris launches the island into space.
The departed island leaves a whirlpool that threatens the team; rescuers and rescued escape together.

notes: Giant-Size X-Men #1 (1975), original Second Genesis account. Later Deadly Genesis retcons are outside this short.
